name: Arpita
heroMessage:
Today the world became brighter and infinitely more beautiful because you're in it. Your grace, that enchanting smile in your red and black sari, and your warmth touch everyone around you.

May this year unfold with endless happiness, breathtaking adventures, and all the love your heart can hold.

Here's to celebrating you today and forever. 🥂
memoriesSubtitle: Every frame holds a moment I treasure forever
